newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Haycarb shares jump 6.67 pct.
newsitem.headline: Haycarb shares jump 6.67 pct.

text.p: Haycarb Ltd rose 6.67 percent, or five rupees, to 80, on Wednesday on expectations that manufacturing shares will perform well this year, brokers said.
"Manufacturing shares are the focus of attention since the sector is expected to do well in 1997," said a local broker.
The manufacturing sector, badly hit by last year's drought and power cuts, is expected to stage a recovery in 1997, he said.
Haycarb, a Hayleys Ltd subsidiary, manufactures and exports activated carbon. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434318
